text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: The paper presents a national-scale spatial land system change model for Cambodia focused explicitly on simulating future land use/land cover (LULC) dynamics under three alternative large-scale land acquisition (LSLA) policy scenarios until 2040. It uses the CLUMondo model to produce mapped LULC projections at 1 km resolution across mainland Cambodia, quantitatively compares scenario outcomes (e.g., tree cover area, natural core areas), and reports quantitative metrics such as percentages of converted vs. unconverted LSLA areas, changes in forest extent, and habitat suitability. The primary research objective is to evaluate how different LSLA governance policies affect future land use patterns, satisfying all core inclusion criteria: national-scale implementation, primary focus on LULC prediction, ≥2 future scenarios with quantitative comparison, spatial modeling with quantitative outputs, and mapped LULC projections. While tiger reintroduction is a conservation application, it serves as an impact metric derived from the LULC predictions, not the primary focus; thus, the ecological component does not trigger exclusion.)
